summary: Frontend-only verification of the two new features (Mortgage Decision Analyzer calculator + dark/light theme) on the public preview URL, plus regression spot-checks of 7 existing calculators. 12 inputs render with step='any' (no HTML5 popup), Calculate produces correct amortization math ($2,528.27 P&I, $510,177.95 total interest, $910,177.95 total payment, LTV 80%), all 8 extras render (score 62/Mixed, 8 factor cards, recharts SVG, 5-row term table, 6-row rate table, key metrics, break-even, insights), SEO title/meta correct, FAQ + related links + finance disclaimer present, /mortgage-decision-calculator alias works with canonical pointing to /calculator/..., listing pages (calculators, category/finance, homepage Popular) all include it. Dark is default on fresh visit, toggle works both ways with localStorage 'calcytub_theme' persistence across reloads and 9 routes incl. /admin, no FOUC (html.dark already set at DOMContentLoaded). Mobile 390px/375px: no horizontal scroll, inputs stack, chart renders, toggle tappable. All existing spot-checked calculators still compute (Home Loan EMI = INR 43,391.16).

issues: Recharts logs a console warning on first mount: 'The width(-1) and height(-1) of chart should be greater than 0' — chart still renders correctly afterwards; consider giving the ResponsiveContainer wrapper an explicit min-height to silence it.

action_items: Content inconsistency (low): mortgage-decision.js workedExample states 'DTI ≈ 39%' but the app (correctly, per its own documented formula including tax+insurance+maintenance) outputs 42.35% for the default inputs. Update the worked example text (and the spec's expected 39%) to 42.4%.

Spec-vs-code expected-value drift for the review checklist only (code math verified correct against the standard amortization formula in Node): 15y monthly = $3,484.43 (checklist said $3,486.45) and 6.375% monthly = $2,495.48 (checklist said $2,494.28). No code change needed; the checklist numbers were slightly off.
Optional: silence recharts width/height(-1) warning with a min-height on the chart container.
critical_code_review_comments: useTheme() keeps theme in component-local state; if a second component ever calls useTheme() the two instances will desync. Currently only Header uses it, but consider lifting to context if the toggle is added elsewhere (e.g. footer/mobile menu).

The FOUC inline script sets document.documentElement.style.background, but reading it back after load returns '' (something clears it). The 'dark' class is applied pre-paint so no visible FOUC — but the inline background fallback is effectively inert.

success_rate.frontend: 100% of 16 checklist items functionally pass (2 checklist numeric expectations were themselves incorrect; app math verified correct independently)

Calculator inputs use id='fld-<key>' (no name attribute) — select with '#fld-rate'. Result labels are uppercased via CSS, so Playwright inner_text returns UPPERCASE; search case-insensitively. Verified this iteration: new mortgage-decision calculator (math + all extras + SEO + alias + listings), dark/light theme default/toggle/persistence/FOUC on 10 routes, mobile 390/375, and regression spot-checks of home-loan-emi, personal-loan-emi, mortgage, sip, fd, gst, bmi.
rca_of_the_issue: Only discrepancy found is documentation/expected-value text: workedExample in mortgage-decision.js quotes DTI 39% while compute() adds property tax, insurance and maintenance to the DTI numerator, yielding 42.35% for defaults. Code is internally consistent; the prose is stale.
